الله.definition:
Arabic for "God" although it directly translates to "The God", it is not a name.

Allah is [the one and only] God and has no partner nor does Allah have a gender.

Allah is the word used (for God) by all Muslims instead of them saying God or in their native language.

Despite us Muslims having the word Allah (for God), it is not used by us (Muslims) only and almost anyone will know and [understand] the meaning of Allah and what you mean.

[Unfortunately], the word Allah gets a bad reputation due to the media portraying it as being violence related which is not true whatsoever.

Luckily, not all people see it that way.
الله.example:
"الله" Meaning "God" or more [directly] as "The God"

[Example]:

Allah does not need me, I need him.

Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.

No one besides Allah can rescue a soul from hardship.

Say, "Who is [the Lord] of the Heavens and Earth?" Say, "Allah"

And whoever puts all his trust in Allah, he will be enough for him.

(Some of these are Quran verses)

اخوووي.definition:
- another word derived from ( اتفرنت,عبداللطيف,ايش بين دا) family.
- the literal meaning is *brother* but in here we are not using it like that.
- it is used when you want to text someone or call someone but instead of saying his name you say the word

- it is [important] to add 2 or 3 (و) vowel [in the middle] of the word because that little vowel you add is what [differentiate] it from it's literal meaning
اخوووي.example:
Abdella6ef: ها اخوووي فيك فرنته ؟ ([search] *اتفرنت* to [understand] [the word] *فرنته*)
Abdelra7man: اكييييد اخووي يلا جاي

اشطة.definition:
هي الطريقة المصرية (العامية) لنطق كلمة قشدة الفصحى (قشطة) ... و تعني عموماً الموافقة على شئ ما أو رأي ما أو إبداء الإعجاب بشئ ما، فهي ضمنياً تعني أن هذا الشئ جميل مثل القشدة! أو تعني أنك موافق على هذا الاقتراح لأنك تراه جميلاً أو مناسباً ... إلخ
قد تُعبِّر أيضاً على الموافقة على مضض أو تُستخدَم كلازمة كلامية.
اشطة.example:
أ: ايه رأيك نروح نشرب حاجة ساقعة بعد الدرس؟
